about: A render is a region read at a resolution: each point named with fewer steps, and what lands on one coarse coordinate
folded together. A reader asks for the resolution it needs, and nothing finer is carried.

cases.name: as fine as the points is the points

coverage.criterion: two steps, one step, and a resolution as fine as the points
coverage.why: one set of three points; the fold's count is the only value read
